```{r}

library(readxl)
#WT_vs_e2fabc <- read_excel("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/Grad/RNA seq data/WT vs e2fabc.xlsx")
#WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311 <- read_excel("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/Grad/RNA seq data/WT vs drdd 21dpg 202311.xlsx")


df_e2f_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_e2fabc$`Upregulated DEGs` )
new <- na.omit(df_e2f_temp)
df_e2f <- data.frame(new)


df_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311$`Upregulated DEGs`)
new <- na.omit(df_temp)
df_drdd <- data.frame(new)

colnames(df_e2f)[1]="e2fabc_upregulated"
colnames(df_drdd)[1]="drdd_upregulated"

head(df_drdd, 10)

list_1 = as.list(df_e2f[1])
list_2 = as.list(df_drdd)
print(list_2)

list = c(list_1, list_2)
print(list)




library("ggvenn")
ggvenn(list, fill_color = c(pink2, yellow2))

ggsave("e2f vs drdd upregulated.png", width=7, height=7)
```

```{r}
#all DEG's grouped together???? 

df_e2f_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_e2fabc$`Upregulated DEGs`)
new <- na.omit(df_e2f_temp)
df_e2f_up <- data.frame(new)


df_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311$`Upregulated DEGs`)
new <- na.omit(df_temp)
df_drdd_up <- data.frame(new)

colnames(df_e2f_up)[1]="e2fabc_upregulated"
colnames(df_drdd_up)[1]="drdd_upregulated"

df_e2f_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_e2fabc$`Downregulate DEGS`)
new <- na.omit(df_e2f_temp)
df_e2f_down <- data.frame(new)


df_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311$`Downregulate DEGS`)
new <- na.omit(df_temp)
df_drdd_down <- data.frame(new)

colnames(df_e2f_down)[1]="e2fabc_downregulated"
colnames(df_drdd_down)[1]="drdd_downregulated"



list_1 = as.list(df_e2f_up)
list_2 = as.list(df_drdd_up)
list_3 = as.list(df_e2f_down)
list_4 = as.list(df_drdd_down)


list = c(list_1, list_2, list_3, list_4)





library("ggvenn")
ggvenn(list, fill_color = c(pink2, yellow2, teal2, purple2))

ggsave("overlap between all e2f and drdd DEG.png", width=7, height=7)
```

```{r}
#Overlap between 21dpg samples, downregulated genes

WT_vs_drdd_21dpg <- read_excel("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/Grad/RNA seq data/WT vs drdd 21dpg.xlsx")


df_old_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_drdd_21dpg$`Downregulate DEGS`)
new <- na.omit(df_old_temp)
df_ben <- data.frame(new)


df_temp <- data.frame(WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311$`Downregulate DEGS`)
new <- na.omit(df_temp)
df_kat <- data.frame(new)

colnames(df_ben)[1]="ben_downregulated"
colnames(df_kat)[1]="kat_downregulated"

list_1 = as.list(df_ben)
list_2 = as.list(df_kat)

list = c(list_1, list_2)

library("ggvenn")
ggvenn(list, fill_color = c(pink2, yellow2))


ggsave("ben vs kat 21dpg downregulated.png", width=7, height=7)

```
